verdict.rationale: RudderStack's API docs describe a public API surface for driving the product programmatically. It covers managing connections, transformations and other features [33], Transformations and Libraries [47], audit logs [67], org-level event usage metrics [66], the Event Audit API [73], and the HTTP and Pixel event APIs [56][54]. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (the probe found 404s at all common paths), no independent or hands-on corroboration of using the management APIs, and endpoint-level depth is unevidenced beyond summary snippets.
